posts.cooked:
Hey all, I just finished a fan-art piece of the harbor-master from the second chapter of the game, and I wanted to share it here! The way the harbor-master’s outfit blends those rugged, sea-weathered textures with bits of almost mystical gear has always fascinated me. I tried to capture that mix of practicality and mystery, especially focusing on the intricate crates and ropes piled around him.

Also, while working on the details, I noticed a weird glitch in the walkthrough where the harbor-master sometimes gets stuck near the dock’s edge, like he glitches through part of the terrain. Super odd, but perfect in a way—it made me think about how this guy almost feels like a ghost anchoring the whole harbor scene. If anyone else has noticed this or has tips on how to fix it from a modding perspective, I’d love to hear!

Anyway, hope you enjoy the art as much as I enjoyed making it. Would love to see what others have created around this enigmatic character too!

posts.cooked:
Wow, this is seriously impressive! You captured the harbor-master’s vibe perfectly—especially the way you got the weathered look on their coat and that subtle worn-out expression. It really feels like a moment frozen right from the game. Also, thanks for the walkthrough tips you shared about avoiding that bug near the docks; I’ve been stuck there forever, and your method saved me from losing hours of progress.

I had a similar issue where the quest wouldn’t trigger after talking to the harbor-master twice, but your suggestion to reload right after the first conversation worked like a charm. It’s so frustrating how little glitches like that pop up in such a beautifully crafted world. Can’t wait to see more of your art, especially if you tackle any other NPCs with equally cool backstories. Keep it up!
